## Play: Corner Hunter

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Corner Hunter (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
A small shop makes two products with limited hours and material. Which mix earns the most? Drag a production plan around the graph and watch the profit and each [constraint]{.term} respond. The game previews [linear programming]{.term}. You'll meet the [feasible region]{.term}, see the difference between a [binding constraint]{.term} and one with [slack]{.term}, and find out why the best plan is always at a [corner point]{.term}.

{{< game corner-hunter title="Corner Hunter" height="820" >}}
:::

## Play: Open Counters

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Open Counters (10 to 20 min)" icon="false"}
How many counters should a help desk open each hour? Too few and the line explodes. Too many and you pay staff to wait for customers. Set a staffing plan, watch a [simulation]{.term} of one day, and compare your cost with the plan that [queueing theory]{.term} recommends. Watch what happens to waiting time as [utilization]{.term} gets close to 100%.

{{< game open-counters title="Open Counters" height="980" >}}
:::
